Reading rule

What these records establish

They establish attribution. A named publisher source supports each admitted claim within an explicit applicability boundary.

They do not establish behavior. No maintainer or independent evaluator installed, ran or reproduced these products.

They preserve uncertainty. Effective model revisions, installed variants, credentials and configuration remain unresolved unless the sources identify them exactly.

Static research artifact. Inclusion is not endorsement; absence is not an adverse finding.
